answer: The admission bond is time locked for 27 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in marble, expire in whisper, and hollow lists each expiry. An adversary running 187 aliases as a result needs 149 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 560 identities would post 1452 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
